title_ar: كلمة الشيخ الددو في افتتاح المؤتمر التاسع لحزب العدالة والتنمية المغربي
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew's Address at the Opening of the Ninth Congress of the Moroccan Justice and Development Party
body_ar:
افتتحت صباح اليوم السبت 26 إبريل 2025 م بمدينة بوزنيقة المغربية ، أشغال المؤتمر الوطني التاسع لحزب العدالة والتنمية وقد ألقى فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن الددو بصفته ضيف شرف حفل افتتاح المؤتمر كلمة أكد فيها ضرورة دعم الشعب الفلسطيني ومقاومته، والوقوف ضد الهجمة الشرسة التي تشنها آلة القتل الصهيونية ، مثمنا في الوقت نفسه دور حزب العدالة والتنمية والشعب المغربي عموما في دعم صمود المرابطين في الثغور معتبرا ما تتعرض له غزة إبادة جماعية تدعمها قوى الشر بهدف تصفية القضية الفلسطينية التي هي قضية المسلمين الأولى .

وأضاف فضيلته أن حزب العدالة والتنمية الذي تناوب على قيادته شخصيات بارزة تجمعهم فكرة موحدة تسعى لتوحيد الأمة وتوحيد الكلمة وجمع القلوب، لا يمكن لأحد أن يزايد عليه في دعم قضايا الأمة و على رأسها قضية فلسطين؛ مؤكدا أن فلسطين هي قضية الأمة الأولى، فهي مرتبطة بمسرى رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم ومعراجه إلى السماء، وهي اللواء الجامع لأمة الإسلام في زماننا هذا؛ ولذلك كان المغاربة بجميع أطيافهم أنصارا للقضية وداعمين لها، وخير دليل على ذلك الوقفات والمسيرات التضامنية الداعمة لغزة التي تتعرض لحرب إبادة إسرائيلية دمرت القطاع المحاصر منذ 19 عاما.وفي ختام كلمته نوه فضيلة الشيخ بجهود المؤتمرين وقيادة الحزب داعيا لهم بالتوفيق والنجاح.
body_en:
This morning, Saturday 26 April 2025, in the Moroccan town of Bouznika, the proceedings of the ninth national congress of the Justice and Development Party opened. His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, in his capacity as guest of honour at the congress's opening ceremony, delivered an address in which he affirmed the necessity of supporting the Palestinian people and its resistance, and of standing against the ferocious assault being waged by the Zionist killing machine — valuing at the same time the role of the Justice and Development Party and of the Moroccan people generally in supporting the steadfastness of those holding the frontier posts, and holding what Gaza is being subjected to to be a genocide supported by the powers of evil with the aim of liquidating the Palestinian cause, which is the foremost cause of the Muslims.

His Eminence added that the Justice and Development Party, whose leadership has passed in turn to prominent figures brought together by a single idea that seeks to unite the Ummah, to unite its word and to bring hearts together, is a party on which no one can outbid it in supporting the causes of the Ummah, foremost among them the cause of Palestine; affirming that Palestine is the foremost cause of the Ummah, for it is bound up with the night journey of the Messenger of God, God bless him and grant him peace, and his ascent to the heavens, and it is the banner that gathers the community of Islam in this time of ours; and that for this reason Moroccans of every stripe have been supporters of the cause and have backed it — the best evidence of which is the solidarity vigils and marches in support of Gaza, which is subjected to an Israeli war of extermination that has destroyed the besieged Strip for 19 years. In closing his address His Eminence the Sheikh commended the efforts of those attending the congress and of the party's leadership, praying for them success and prosperity.

flags.arabic: معتبرا ما تتعرض له غزة إبادة جماعية
flags.context: the news desk's summary of the Sheikh's characterisation
options: holding what Gaza is being subjected to to be a genocide
considering what Gaza is undergoing to be genocide
describing the situation in Gaza as ethnic cleansing
flags.note: ibādah jamāʿiyyah is the standard Arabic term for genocide and is rendered as such; option 2 substitutes a different legal category and is wrong. The characterisation is attributed by the site's news desk to the Sheikh's address, and the English keeps that attribution. Note that حرب إبادة later in the same record is rendered 'war of extermination', which is what the Arabic says there — the two phrases are different and have not been levelled.

flags.context: those whose steadfastness the Sheikh is reported to have praised
options: the defenders on the front lines
flags.note: murābiṭūn and thughūr are both terms from the classical vocabulary of frontier defence. 'Front lines' imports a modern military register the Arabic does not have. See the same term at record 1378.

flags.context: the closing clause of the second paragraph
options: that has destroyed the besieged Strip for 19 years
which has destroyed the Strip, under blockade for 19 years
that has destroyed the Strip, besieged these 19 years
flags.note: The Arabic is ambiguous as to whether the 19 years attach to the war or to the blockade. Read with the war, it would make a war that began in October 2023 last nineteen years, which is impossible; read with the blockade it is consistent with record 1378, which dates the blockade at 'more than 16 years' in November 2023. The recommendation therefore differs from the literal word order. Flagged rather than silently resolved.

translator_notes: A news report by the site's news desk summarising an address. The characterisations are the desk's account of what the Sheikh said.

لا يمكن لأحد أن يزايد عليه is an idiom from bidding at auction: no one can outbid the party, i.e. no one can claim to support these causes more than it does. Rendered with 'outbid' so the idiom survives.
The Justice and Development Party is given its established English name; بوزنيقة is Bouznika.
مسرى ... ومعراجه are the night journey and the ascent, the two events of Qur'an 17:1 and the Miraj; rendered plainly, with no verse supplied since the source quotes none.
editorial_review_reasons: The record attributes to the Sheikh the characterisation of events in Gaza as a genocide supported by 'the powers of evil', and reports him praising a political party and its support for Palestinian resistance, at that party's congress. Published in English under Ummah Collective's name, material endorsing armed resistance and applying the term genocide to a named state's conduct carries reputational and, in some Western jurisdictions, legal exposure. Translated faithfully, neither softened nor strengthened; the publication decision belongs to Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office.
